## OperatorFamily type

The upstream numeric families: uint32 token operators and uint8 option states. A family name identifies the Go named type, not the spelling of one token.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type OperatorFamily =
  | 'BinAritOperator'
  | 'BinCmdOperator'
  | 'BinTestOperator'
  | 'CaseOperator'
  | 'GlobOperator'
  | 'OptState'
  | 'ParExpOperator'
  | 'ParNamesOperator'
  | 'ProcOperator'
  | 'RedirOperator'
  | 'UnAritOperator'
  | 'UnTestOperator';
```
